column1: # Rule cases for rules.bats (ADR 0143): id  polarity(+|-)  placement  text
# Placements: build (into build()), install (into post_install), top
# (PKGBUILD top level), file (extra helper.sh), source / source-skip (an
# extra source, real / SKIP sum), nosrcinfo (drop .SRCINFO), pkgbase,
# heredoc / shheredoc (a `cat` / `sh` heredoc body in post_install).
# @BLOB@ expands to a 120-char base64 run. path ("<relpath>::<content>"),
# sums (swap the sha256 algorithm, e.g. md5), srcinfo (a .SRCINFO-only line).
